project.name: Lil Magnet Memories
project.description: E2E tests for Lil Magnet Memories – custom photo magnets, market events, and online orders.

testPlans.name: Site presence – test.lilmagnetmemories.com
testPlans.description: Live site smoke: landing sections, photo upload shell, About/Contact/FAQ, custom products, header and drawer. Suite: site-components.

testCases.description: Title, hero, How It Works, Shop Our Products, logo, reviews heading; optional market-event CTA.

testCases.name: Photo upload page shows form shell
testCases.description: Photo Upload Form, delivery line, Your Information, First Name field.

testCases.name: About, Contact, and FAQ pages load
testCases.description: /about, /contact-us, /faq main headings and copy.

testCases.name: Custom products catalog page loads
testCases.description: /products/custom title and subtitle.

testCases.name: Header brand and navigation entry
testCases.description: Li'l Magnet Memories in header; drawer Navigation + Home.

testPlans.description: Core flows: landing, photo upload entry, and key navigation.

testCases.description: Online order with Apple Pay and standard shipping.

testCases.description: Thank you page buttons (Submit Another Order, Back to Home) and navigation.

testCases.name: Market Event Live - No Toggle - Answer YES to Popup

testCases.name: Market Event Live - No Toggle - Answer NO to Popup
testCases.description: Popup → No, Order Online → photo upload in online mode.

testCases.name: Market Event Live - Toggle OFF Explicitly - No Popup
testCases.description: Toggle off before Start Creating; no popup; photo upload in online mode.
